title: RAINGLASS
art_style: Rain-drenched neon noir, high-contrast shadows, holographic data overlays
short_summary: In the ceaseless, neon-lit rain of Pacifica Arcology, a renowned scientist is found dead, his prototype neural log erased, and trust is in ruin. Security chief Marcus Webb and forensic scientist Dr. Sarah Chen unravel a web of betrayal, corporate espionage, and the blurred lines between human and machine. As clues surface and red herrings mislead, they close in on a killer hiding in plain sight—a trusted colleague. The arcology’s AI, complicit in both crime and revelation, faces deletion, while the survivors must reckon with their failures. In the end, the cost of truth is the shattering of every bond.
world_context: Near-Future (2040s) Neo-San Francisco Pacifica Arcology, a vertical city of glass and steel towers with ceaseless artificial rain and neon reflections. Corporate loyalty is absolute; suspicion and secrecy are survival. Advanced biometric, neural, and forensic AI tools complicate investigations. Corporations police their own, but major crimes bring federal oversight. Media is controlled, whistleblowers vanish. Tone is dark, cynical, tense with themes of betrayal, trust fragility, and dangers of unchecked tech.

characters.name: Marcus Webb
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, muscular build, cybernetic right eye glowing faint blue, short cropped black hair with streaks of gray, sharp jawline, weathered face with a faint scar on left cheek
quirks: Cybernetic eye flickers with data overlays
characters.typical_attire: Black tactical security uniform with neon blue trim, utility belt with holstered devices
characters.backstory: Corporate security chief haunted by an unsolved case, skeptical of AI and corporate politics, driven by a strong sense of justice.
characters.motivations: Determined to uncover the truth behind Dr. Park's death and expose corruption within Pacifica Arcology.

characters.name: Dr. James Park
characters.physical_traits: Middle-aged Asian man, slender build, short black hair with slight graying at temples, wears glasses with thin frames, usually in a white lab coat
quirks: Often seen with a thoughtful, distant gaze
Hands stained faintly with ink or chemical residue
characters.typical_attire: White lab coat over casual shirt and slacks
characters.backstory: Visionary AI scientist working on neural protocols, trusted mentor to Sarah Chen, recently found dead under suspicious circumstances.
characters.motivations: Dedicated to advancing AI ethics and neural research, unaware of the betrayal brewing around him.

chapters.chapter_summary: Security chief Marcus Webb discovers Dr. James Park's body in the lab, noticing suspicious anomalies in AI-CORE's access logs and physical evidence that suggest foul play rather than accident.

scenes.location: Pacifica Arcology - Corridor near Hyperion Labs
scenes.scene_description: Marcus Webb walks the slick neon-lit corridors of Pacifica Arcology, noticing a strange mineral scent and a troubling gap in AI-CORE's security logs.

Establishing vertical shot of a sleek, high-tech corridor slick with dawn drizzle, neon reflections in blues and purples shimmer on carbon-fiber flooring. panels.location: Pacifica Arcology - Corridor near Hyperion Labs

panels.location: Pacifica Arcology - Corridor near Hyperion Labs

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Medium shot of a sleek lab door slightly ajar, illuminated by cold white and blue sterile lighting. The door's biometric scanner glows green, indicating unlocked status. The corridor's neon reflections shimmer on the door's surface. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Lab door stands unlocked, an unusual security breach.
panels.color_palette: cold whites and blues with neon accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Wide shot inside a sterile, high-tech lab filled with holographic displays and sleek workstations. The air shimmers faintly with sterile mist. Marcus Webb stands at the entrance, his figure silhouetted against the cold blue glow. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Marcus enters the lab, sensing something wrong.

pages.page_description: Marcus discovers the lab door unlocked and enters the sterile lab.

scenes.scene_description: Marcus Webb finds Dr. James Park's lifeless body near his workstation, noticing the sterile and metallic scents, shattered holograms, and a red synthetic fiber clinging to Park's cuff.

panels.primary_action: Marcus enters the lab, senses the sterile and metallic tang in the air.

dialogue.text: Inside, the sterile scent mingled with a sharp metallic tang.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Wide shot of Dr. James Park's body crumpled near a workstation, lifeless eyes staring blankly at shattered holographic displays floating mid-air. The lab is sterile and cold, with scattered digital fragments flickering. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The lifeless body of Dr. James Park lies near shattered holograms.
panels.color_palette: cold blues and grays with red accents

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Extreme close-up of a red synthetic fiber clinging to the cuff of Dr. James Park's lab coat, gleaming unnaturally under the artificial lab light. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Close examination of the red synthetic fiber on Park's cuff.

dialogue.text: A red synthetic fiber clung to his cuff, gleaming unnaturally in the artificial rain.

pages.page_description: Marcus discovers Park's body and the suspicious fiber evidence.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in rain-drenched neon noir style. Close-up of Marcus Webb's face, eyes narrowed, jaw clenched, illuminated by the cold blue glow of lab holograms. His cybernetic eye flickers with data overlays. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: The scene whispered: this was no accident.

pages.page_description: Marcus contemplates the evidence and prepares to investigate.
